name: Cashew Butter
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as cashews are low FODMAP, but high fat content may slow digestion in some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Choose natural cashew butter without added sugars or high FODMAP ingredients
Store in refrigerator to prevent rancidity
Stir well before use as natural oils separate
Check labels for garlic or onion powder additives
nutritionalHighlights: Magnesium for muscle and nerve function
